lang.description: BCP-47 language tag for the text.

page.description: AT-URI of the work.sequential.page or work.sequential.slice being commented on. Must belong to the subject chapter. Omit to comment on the whole chapter, and always omit when the subject is a strip. Replies keep the page of the comment they reply to. Use the DID form (at://did:...), not a handle.

panel.description: Zero-based index of the panel being commented on, in the panels of the page, or of the strip when the subject is a strip. Omit to comment on the whole page or strip. Slices have no panels. Indexes can shift when the creator re-cuts panels; AppViews ignore indexes past the last panel. Replies keep the panel of the comment they reply to.

facets.description: Annotations of text: mentions, links, hashtags and styles (bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code, spoiler).

parent.description: AT-URI of the work.sequential.feed.comment being replied to. Omit for a top-level comment. Use the DID form (at://did:...), not a handle.

subject.description: AT-URI of the work.sequential.chapter or work.sequential.strip being commented on. AppViews ignore comments on any other record. Comments on a page, slice or panel still set subject to the chapter or strip, so AppViews can count a work's comments without walking pages. Replies keep the subject of the comment they reply to. Use the DID form (at://did:...), not a handle.

createdAt.description: The date and time the comment was created.

main.description: A comment on a chapter or strip, or on one of its pages, slices or panels, or a reply to another comment.
